text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun emerged victorious over 
Narita Brian. After the race, she catches 
sight of a dissatisfied-looking Narita 
Brian.

Having wanted to enjoy competing against 
her, Mayano Top Gun wished for another 
chance to race against Narita Brian.

And Mayano Top Gun set her next goal as 
the Tenno Sho (Spring), just like Narita 
Brian.
